0.name: TEXT_FESXMS2018_00536_GUIDEXMS2018_000_000
0.description: Welcome to the Starlight Celebration! I am here to answer any questions you might have about the festival. What would you like to know?
0.translation_description: Benvenuto alla Celebrazione delle Stelle! Sono qui per rispondere a ogni tua domanda sulla festa. Che cosa vuoi sapere?

2.name: TEXT_FESXMS2018_00536_A1_000_001
2.translation_description: Che cos’è la Celebrazione delle Stelle?

3.name: TEXT_FESXMS2018_00536_A1_000_002
3.description: What's your task in all this?

5.name: TEXT_FESXMS2018_00536_GUIDEXMS2018_000_010
5.description: The Starlight Celebration can be traced back to ancient Ishgard. Long ago, a terrible battle claimed countless lives, leaving thousands of children orphaned in the harsh cold weather of Coerthas.
5.translation_description: La Celebrazione delle Stelle ha origine nell’antica Ishgard. Molto tempo fa, una terribile battaglia causò innumerevoli vittime, lasciando migliaia di bambini orfani nel rigido clima di Coerthas.

6.name: TEXT_FESXMS2018_00536_GUIDEXMS2018_000_011
6.description: Unable to bear their suffering, Ishgardian knights would offer these children board and lodging within their barracks. Of course, this was expressly forbidden, but the knights devised a plan to sneak them in, disguising the children in jackets of their scarlet uniforms.
6.translation_description: Incapaci di sopportare la loro sofferenza, i cavalieri ishgardiani offrivano vitto e alloggio a questi bambini nelle proprie caserme. Era severamente proibito, naturalmente, ma i cavalieri escogitarono un piano per introdurli di nascosto, travestendoli con le giubbe scarlatte delle loro uniformi.

7.name: TEXT_FESXMS2018_00536_GUIDEXMS2018_000_012
7.description: Owing to their generosity, the children survived the winter and lived to pay forward the kindness they had received. The former orphans would adorn themselves in scarlet uniforms, delivering gifts to children on the coldest week of the year. Thus, the Starlight Celebration was born.
7.translation_description: Grazie alla loro generosità, i bambini sopravvissero all’inverno e, crescendo, ricambiarono la gentilezza ricevuta. Gli orfani ormai adulti indossavano uniformi scarlatte e portavano doni ai bambini durante la settimana più fredda dell’anno. Così nacque la Celebrazione delle Stelle.

8.name: TEXT_FESXMS2018_00536_GUIDEXMS2018_000_013
8.description: Over the years, the celebration has undergone gradual changes. The snowy-bearded captain of the kind-hearted knights has become known as the “Saint of Nymeia,” and children believe that he delivers their hopes and prayers directly to the goddess Herself.
8.translation_description: Con il passare degli anni, la festa è cambiata gradualmente. Il capitano barbuto dei cavalieri gentili è diventato il «Santo di Nymeia» e i bambini credono che porti le loro speranze e preghiere direttamente alla dea.

9.name: TEXT_FESXMS2018_00536_GUIDEXMS2018_000_014
9.description: Similarly, his red-jacketed knights have become the “saint's little helpers.” They are particularly beloved by the younglings, for it is their role to bring gifts to every child who sends a prayer to the Spinner.
9.translation_description: Allo stesso modo, i suoi cavalieri dalla giubba rossa sono diventati i «piccoli aiutanti del santo». I bambini li adorano, perché portano doni a ogni fanciullo che rivolge una preghiera alla Tessitrice.

10.name: TEXT_FESXMS2018_00536_GUIDEXMS2018_000_020
10.description: My scarlet-clad colleagues and I have been charged by the Adventurers' Guild with running the Starlight Celebration. The festival spans the entire realm of Eorzea, and we have little helpers stationed in the cities of Gridania, Limsa Lominsa, and Ul'dah.
10.translation_description: A me e ai miei colleghi in scarlatto la Gilda degli Avventurieri ha affidato l’organizzazione della Celebrazione delle Stelle. La festa si svolge in tutta Eorzea, e abbiamo piccoli aiutanti nelle città di Gridania, Limsa Lominsa e Ul’dah.

11.name: TEXT_FESXMS2018_00536_GUIDEXMS2018_000_021
11.description: On this particular occasion, we will be hosting a concert here in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, with a choir reviving Ishgardian traditions of eld─A rare treat not to be missed!
11.translation_description: Per l’occasione, qui all’Anfiteatro di Mih Khetto terremo un concerto con un coro che farà rivivere le antiche tradizioni ishgardiane. Un’occasione rara da non perdere!

12.name: TEXT_FESXMS2018_00536_GUIDEXMS2018_000_022
12.description: To spread yet more festive cheer, each child in attendance will receive a special gift at the end of the show. It is sure to draw in crowds from every corner of the realm.
12.translation_description: Per portare ancora più allegria, alla fine dello spettacolo ogni bambino presente riceverà un dono speciale. Sarà un’attrazione capace di richiamare gente da ogni angolo del regno.
